cross_product_finding: This page makes explicit what is otherwise implicit across the batches: Sync Gateway runs TWO parallel, unrelated identity/authorization systems side by side. (1) Sync Gateway users/roles - channel-based, no fixed privilege enum, govern the Public (data-sync) API; this is the novel shape for this stress test. (2) Couchbase Server RBAC users - the same named-privilege system covered in the server/ batch - reused verbatim to gate the Admin and Metrics APIs. The doc is explicit that these do NOT compose ('have no relationship'), which is itself a useful negative finding: unlike Capella, where credential types are keyed into a single privilege system, Sync Gateway deliberately keeps its data-plane authorization (channels/roles) and its control-plane authorization (server RBAC) as two disjoint graphs.
